terra.problem: The passage says God will create new heavens and a new earth, but does not say the old sky and ground get replaced.
The line about being tired makes a joke about the person's age. Jokes about age are off limits.
The explanation repeats the verse without explaining it or adding much of Papa Dorin's voice.
This is a generic restatement of the verse. It could help the baker understand what 'considered accursed' means.
Saying nobody walks off from their own front door adds a detail the passage does not give.
The comparison suggests the LORD cuts people off mid-sentence. The verse says He hears while they are still speaking and answers before they call.
The joke characterizes the LORD's response as cutting someone off, making His action the subject of the joke.
No birds being invited is an invented detail. The verse simply does not mention an eagle.
The image of the lion on the counter has no clear connection to the point and blends the Bible picture with Papa Dorin's bakery.
The verse says the lion will eat straw like the ox, not that it will eat next to an ox.
The explanation is a flat repetition of the statement and quotation, followed by a generic note that it is in the last verse.
